It states: "In the case of agricultural labor, the term 'employer' means, with respect to any calendar year, any person who- ... (B) on each of some 10 days during the calendar year or during the preceding calendar year, each day being in a different calendar week, employed at least 5 individuals in employment in agricultural labor for some portion of the day."
